HFrEF is a manifestation of the cardiac sarcoidosis, not its cause.

Ventricular tachycardia is a major presentation of the underlying cardiac sarcoidosis.
Patchy enhancement and PET granulomatous activity support sarcoidosis rather than amyloidosis.
Dilated cardiomyopathy describes the structural consequence but not the granulomatous etiology.
Giant-cell myocarditis is a distinct entity from PET-supported cardiac sarcoidosis.
